[[File:Jared Bronson portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Jared Bronson.]]
'''Jared Bronson''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 78 FL from SLC, Ut. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He bought the game on release in December 1995 and was a tournament director in Salt Lake City for over a year before joining the squadron.<ref name="decsq-prof">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/bronsonjared.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Gold 78 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010117070600/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/bronsonjared.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
The day it hit the stores in December of '95 I threw down my credit card for some boxes.

The cards sat opened in their display box for a couple months until I found someone to teach me how to play and to build a deck. After that, it was all over.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
